one_line: A numbered list promise with a credential in the first frame, then one comment word that delivers a real file.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static medium shot, a woman waves and smiles at a sukkah entrance. Said (transcript): the kids' decorations will also build development. Text: "5 רעיונות לקישוטי סוכה שמפתחים מיומנויות ממרפאה בעיסוק" in a box, word chunks above.
q1_hook.why: A numbered promise plus a professional credential in the first frame tells a parent what they get and why to trust it (H1, T3, H2). A smiling face speaking from 0:00 (H4), with the line both said and written (H6). She waves but speaks content at once, so it is not a slow open.

beats.what: She waves at the sukkah entrance; headline box and word chunks appear
beats.why: Face, voice and a numbered promise from the first frame

beats.what: Decorations hanging in the sukkah, her hanging a paper chain, a rainbow fan close-up at 0:06
beats.why: Shows the kind of result before any steps

beats.what: Children colour at a table; subtitles: "תהליך ההכנה עצמו", "הרבה מיומנויות"
beats.why: Gives a parent a reason to care: the making builds skills

beats.what: Label "1. פנסים לתלייה"; painting, cutting, folding and stapling a paper lantern from above
beats.why: First labelled idea; each cut or fold is a new step

beats.what: Label "2. מובייל כוכבים"; fluo markers colour stars, then they are folded and glued
beats.why: New colours and a new craft reset attention

beats.what: Label "3. שרשראות מעוצבות"; colouring paper strips, a marker box held up, stapling a chain
beats.why: Third idea keeps the same rhythm, so the pattern is easy to follow

beats.what: Label "4. מניפות"; oil pastels on white paper, folded into a rainbow fan
beats.why: Thirteen seconds on one idea is the slowest stretch

beats.what: Label "5. שרשרת דגלים"; drawing on bunting; subtitle "תשמרו את הריל" at 0:53
beats.why: A save ask lands as the last idea starts

beats.what: Card and voice: comment "סוכה" for the file; punching and piling the finished flags
beats.why: The offer comes after all five ideas, over a finished-result shot

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Comment "סוכה" for the file, said and shown from 0:59 and in the caption. A subtitled save ask, "תשמרו את הריל", at 0:53. Steps for ideas 1 to 4 sit in the caption.
q2_flow.why: The numbered label gives each idea its own start and a place to rejoin (R3, R7). Close top-down hands change the picture about every 2 s (E2). At 66 s, with a skills voiceover that does not narrate the steps, the middle runs long (R1, R2). The file offer gives a reason to reach the end (R6).

q3_cta.what: Subtitled 0:59-1:03: "קובץ הקישוטים?", "תכתבו לי בתגובות", "את המילה", "ואשלח לכם". Card 0:59 to the end: "כתבו בתגובות את המילה "סוכה" ואשלח לכם את הקובץ". Caption line 4: the same word.
q3_cta.why: One generic holiday word, said, shown and repeated in the caption, after five demos (C3, C6). The file is a real benefit (C2, R6). Weak spots: a save ask at 0:53 (against C1); the card sits mid-frame over the hands; the ask is in caption line 4, not line 1.

q4_shown.what: Her face and the sukkah 0:00-0:05, finished decorations, children colouring 0:07-0:10, then five hands-only top-down demos, each ending on the finished piece. Giotto boxes and markers in frame (Giant Fluo 0:22, Curve 0:31, oil pastels 0:40, Turbo Color 0:57). No price.
q4_shown.why: The finished decorations come first, then the process (H2, S4). The credential in the headline and her first-person use of the products add trust (S6). The brand is in frame as props for roughly a third of the Reel, above the quarter guide (C7), though never as a logo card (H3).

q5_edit.what: About 39 shots in 66 s (first-pass count, about 1.7 s each), straight cuts, mostly static top-down steps. A numbered label stays up per idea (9 to 13 s); subtitles change about every second. Ends on the bunting pile under the CTA card.
q5_edit.why: Frequent cuts keep the picture changing (E2, R3), and short subtitles synced to the voice suit sound-off viewing (E4, T2). The voiceover runs wall to wall with no breathing room (R1). It stops right after the CTA, but 66 s is long for a craft tip (E8, R2).

q6_topic.what: Five Sukkot decoration crafts for children, framed by an occupational therapist as skill-building; it serves parents looking for holiday activities.
q6_topic.why: A dated holiday need answered with ready-to-do ideas (K7, R7). The developmental reason is modest, a practice opportunity, and comes from a professional (K4). Skills are listed in the voiceover with no story or laugh, so the feeling comes only from bright colours (K1, K2).

q7_filmed.what: Static medium shot at the sukkah entrance in daylight; a low-angle handheld of the ceiling; handheld over-the-shoulder children at a table; from 0:11 static top-down hands on a grey table, bright even light, product boxes in frame.
q7_filmed.why: Face, voice and daylight at the start feel personal (H8, F6). Static top-down hands on a clean table fill the frame and make each step readable (F4, F5, S4). Bright paper on grey gives strong contrast on a phone screen (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:05 grey translucent box, about 64 to 75 percent down: "5 רעיונות לקישוטי סוכה שמפתחים מיומנויות ממרפאה בעיסוק"; word chunks at the top: "הילדים שלכם עומדים", "הכי מושלמים". From 0:06 white bold 1 to 4 word subtitles about 70 percent down. Label boxes about 16 percent down from 0:11: "1. פנסים לתלייה" to "5. שרשרת דגלים". 0:59 to the end: the comment-word card, centred.
q8_text.caption: "קבלו 5 רעיונות לקישוטים הכי יפים שתכינו לסוכה". About 223 words, cut off mid-step 4: promise, credential, comment-word ask in line 4, the Giotto mention, then numbered steps. No question; no hashtags seen.
q8_text.why: Keyword subtitles and numbered labels make it readable on mute (T1, T2). Headline and subtitles sit partly in the bottom 35% (T4). The first caption line carries promise and holiday keyword (T7); the steps give a reason to save (R7). The Giotto mention in line 5 has no "partnership" word (T8).

weak_points: 66 s with a skills voiceover that does not narrate the steps; the CTA card covers the hands for 7 s; a save ask plus a comment ask; subtitles in the bottom 35%; disclosure words only in caption line 5.
lumebook_takeaway: Film an "N ideas" Reel with top-down hands and one numbered label per idea; offer a free printable page for one comment word. Cut it shorter than this.
not_verified: Music (speech runs wall to wall, so music cannot be told). Whether the voice over the hands is the same woman. Whether the comment reply delivers the file. Step 5 and any hashtags (the saved caption ends mid-step 4). The machine transcript mishears "קישוטים", so burned-in subtitles were used. Corrections: Giotto packaging is first legible at 0:09, not 6 s; the rainbow fan close-up at 0:06 is an extra shot before the children at 0:07; the CTA card runs about 7 s from 0:59, not 6 s; a save ask at 0:53 is not in the first pass.
